name: Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort
positioning: Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa: a Spanish Colonial-inspired golf, spa and water park resort on 240 acres in Rancho Mirage, near Palm Springs
best_for: Families who want an on-site water park with a lazy river and sandy beach
Golfers who want 27 holes with mountain views
Couples who want spa time in the desert

facts.text: The resort is in Rancho Mirage and sits on 240 acres in the heart of the Coachella Valley near Palm Springs, California.
The resort is set amid a mountainous backdrop surrounded by palms.
Splashtopia, the resort's water park, offers two acres of family-friendly water activities including slides, a lazy river and a splashpad.
The resort has 27 holes of golf made up of three nine-hole courses.
The resort has a full-service spa.
Plaza rooms are steps away from the spa.
Suites have dedicated living spaces and connecting room options.
The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
The resort has a fully equipped fitness center.
There are six dining outlets: three full-service restaurants, two pool bars and a cafe.
Palm Springs International Airport is approximately 10 miles away.

highlights.text: The Splashtopia water park has a cliff-side hot tub, a sandy beach, a lazy river and water-play zones with fountains and sprinklers.
The golf has views of the San Bernardino and San Jacinto mountains and is played on three rotations: North, South and West.
Guest rooms and suites are inspired by Spanish Colonial design, with French doors that open out to patios or balconies.
Lakeview rooms have a furnished patio or balcony overlooking the water on the golf course.

considerations.text: Self-parking and valet parking both carry a nightly charge.
Pets are welcome only in specific buildings, must be under 50 pounds, and there is a per-pet charge for each stay.
WhataHotel notes it is a large property, so reaching some amenities takes a walk.
